spans.s: याद् only या॑दमान closely connected with (instr.).
यदर्थ a. having which object or intention.
यदर्थम् a. for which purpose, wherefore.
यद˚र्थे a. for which purpose, wherefore.
कदा चिद् at every time, always.
यदीय a. whose, belonging to whom, which, or what.

य॑दु m. N. of an ancient hero & his race;
 cf. तुर्व॑श.
यद्गोत्र a. belonging to what family.
यद्देवत a. having which godhead or divinity.
यद्धेतोस् (abl. adv.) from which reason or motive.

यद्भविष्य m. Fatalist, N. of a fish (lit. what will
be, scil. will be).
यद्रि॑यञ्च् a. moving or turned in which direction.
यद्र्य॑ञ्च् a. moving or turned in which direction.

यद्वत् adv. as, in what manner, as surely as (correl. to
तद्वत् or एवम्).
यद्वा v. य॑द्.
या॑द्व a. belonging to the race of Yadu.
यद्विध a. of what sort.
यद्वृत्त n. occurrence, event, adventure.
यादवशार्दूल m. E. of Kṛṣṇa.
यादवेन्द्र m. E. of Kṛṣṇa.
या॑दस् n. sea monster.
या॑दुर a. embracing voluptuously.
यादृग्गुण a. of what qualities.
यादृच्छिक a. spontaneous, accidental.
यादृ॑श् f. ई which like, qualis.
या˚दृ॑श f. ई which like, qualis.
याद्राध्य॑म् adv. as well or as quickly as possible.
